title: Momoi Airi — Cat Sister Mischief!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got here a bit too early.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh well. The proposals for our stream are all done, so I'll just sit and relax while I wait for the others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That reminds me... After the show, everyone sent me those videos of Nyantaro...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still haven't had a chance to look at them all yet, so I think I'll watch some now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, play...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
<Oh, Nyantaro, how can we help you?
Did you come to play with us again?>

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro's Voice
rows.Line: <Meow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Nyantaro...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
He must really love Tenma.
Just look at the way he's brushing up against his legs. I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
<Hey, Nyantaro!
Let's take a picture together! C'mon, join us!>

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
<Oh, he's coming this way!
Alright, let's all make peace signs!>

rows.Speaker: Nene's Voice
rows.Line: <Umm... L-Like this?>

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro's Voice
rows.Line: <Meow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They've all become friends with Nyantaro.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Let's see... What about this video...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nyantaro's lying on Minori's lap?!
Th-This video was here the entire time...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only I could've pet him myself...

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro's Voice
rows.Line: <Meow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, Airi, Nyantaro's looking your way now.>

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: <Hehe. What's up? Are you interested in me now?>

rows.Speaker: Nyantaro's Voice
rows.Line: <Meow.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
He was staring right at me here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What if...?
Did he realize that I couldn't go near him...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, that's just wishful thinking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm really glad he didn't forget about me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, you're here very early.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You beat us here. We thought we were going to be the first ones to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Morning. Did you all come here together today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We just happened to run into each other...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? The video you're watching... Is that Nyantaro?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you talking about the cat you two met at that carnival?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I was watching some videos she and the others took while we were there. Here, check it out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, let me see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow, he's adorable.
I can see why you like him so much, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! He's just absolutely precious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, just look at the way his eyes twinkle when he looks up at the camera! It's like he's casting a spell on you! I can't look away for even a second!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. He's that mesmerizing, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I think I know what she means. I'd probably give him everything he wants if he looked at me like this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Cats really do the cutest things...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just the other day, I saw this video that's been going viral where a cat paws at its owner's feet!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I saw that too!
The way it was trying to get its owner's attention...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Imagine having a cat that loves you that much. The owner must be the happiest person in the world...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Minori... When we saw that video, you said that Samo does something similar.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! Whenever he wants to go for a walk, he begs by pawing at my feet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He'll even use his puppy dog eyes on me!
And it works every single time...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No matter how tired I am, I end up wanting to fulfill his wish!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure he's very cute when he does that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He is! I'll take a video next time and send it to you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But Samo's also really cute when he takes naps in the sun. Like, he'll roll on his back by the window and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hold on... We might have something here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This feels like a great idea for a stream segment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We could have us talk all about the cute things animals do and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The look on your face while you talked about Samo just now was perfect, Minori. I bet our fans would love seeing that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree... You did make a wonderful expression just now, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm also for this idea.
Segments surrounding animals rank pretty high in popularity, so I'm sure our fans will enjoy this segment.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hold on! Does that mean I get to talk about all the cute things Samo does?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. It's your chance to tell us everything about him.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, we basically had a meeting before we even started...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see no problem with that.
We have a good discussion going, so let's make this the meeting.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point.
In that case, let's start hammering out the details.
